verdict.rationale: Ente's docs describe an offline mode: choosing "Use without backups" lets you use the app without an account, with codes stored only on the device. This is reinforced by the "Use without an account" product claim and by the ability to import encrypted backups without signing in. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that code generation needs no network connectivity at all, independent or hands-on corroboration of account-free offline use.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: Ente Auth can be used without an account by choosing **Use without backups**. In offline mode, your codes are stored only on that device.
you can easily import the encrypted backup without signing in
